An Italian political leader's remarks at the Bharat Summit 2026 in Hyderabad have triggered a major political controversy in India.
Giacomo Filibeck, Secretary General of the Party of European Socialists (PES), raised the slogan "Vote Chor, Gaddi Chhod" while expressing support for Congress leader Rahul Gandhi and raising concerns about democracy in India.
The remarks sparked sharp reactions from the BJP, with Union Home Minister Amit Shah and Union Minister Kiren Rijiju questioning the Congress party over the involvement of a foreign political leader in India's domestic politics.
